feeds.title: Ismailimail » Islamic Art
feeds.description: Ismailimail has been sharing thousands of inter and intra-faith stories of achievements and excellence from the community, which promotes a balance between the spiritual and material worlds. It's home to a vast collection of stories & news of Islamic Art.

feeds.title: Islamic Illumination Blog
feeds.description: Islamic Illumination Blog is educational and inspirational about patterns inspired by nature and the illumination painting style. Her work is a mixture of traditional methods and contemporary experimental approaches. She posts about the art of Islamic illumination, tezhip, traditional art, Islamic tiles and more

feeds.title: Sandykurt.com Blog
feeds.description: Sandy Kurt is an artist, self-taught designer, and educator, who is hell-bent on teaching everyone how to get started with Islamic patterns. Her blog is packed with insights and tips about Islamic geometric patterns: tools and supplies, books, drawing and painting tips, and more.

feeds.title: Islamic Arts Magazine
feeds.description: Islamic Arts Magazine presents artists, exhibitions and events from Islamic World. The topics range from traditional to contemporary and cover all media & contribute to a better understanding of Islamic culture. Read articles, events, features, exhibitions, awards, art collections and more.

feeds.title: Islamic Wall Art Store Blog » Islamic Wall Art
feeds.description: Islamic Wall Art manufactures high-quality, elegant and affordable Islamic Art. We design and manufacture metal and acrylic-coated Islamic Art. Posts about Metal, Wood and Glass Islamic Home Decor, Prices, Reviews and Suggestions for Islamic Wall Hanging Decorative Products.

feeds.title: Isabelle Imbert Ph.D. Blog
feeds.description: Isabelle Imbert is an Islamic Art specialist who is also a Researcher, Teacher, Writer, Art Market Expert and Speaker as well as host of the newly formed 'ART Informant' podcast. Her blog is home to Islamic Art and info.

feeds.title: Unique Wall Art Blog
feeds.description: Unique Wall Art is home to high-quality, handmade Islamic home décor in UK and Europe. You'll be able to find Arabic calligraphy wall art, wall clocks, floor lamps, chandeliers, table décor, and more. Get ideas and inspiration from our blog.

feeds.title: Anita Chowdry Blog » Islamic Art History
feeds.description: Anita Chowdry a visual artist, researcher and educator created this blog as a platform to share observations and some of the projects and creative ideas that she has been involved with. Read Islamic Art History to know more.

feeds.title: Saleha Art Blog
feeds.description: Saleha is a Muslim artist sharing her thoughts and experiences to relearn Islam & the artist of Saleha Art. She has found a creative way of telling Islamic stories by combining Islamic abstract art and calligraphy. Read Rebuild Your Faith as she shares her lecture notes and personal experiences.

feeds.title: Saeid Shakouri Blog
feeds.description: Saeid Shakouri is an educator, architect & researcher in traditional Persian Art & Architecture, Islamic Art & Architecture. The blog has creative, innovative, DIY ideas, meanings, origins, facts, evolution, architecture, Islamic geometric patterns and more.
